_comment: Grandfathered count of live tables that look like real entities (audit.unregistered_candidates, base_col_score >= 4) and are NOT in platform.entity_types, MINUS unregistered-entities-allowlist.json. Ratchet only DOWN: the gate fails when the live count EXCEEDS this. Register a table (platform.create_entity_table) or allowlist it WITH A REASON, then shrink this with: pnpm check:unregistered-entities --update-baseline. Raising it is an Arman decision.
